source: V20 core, Paths of Enlightenment, pp. 316-340. The keys are the system sheet's Path choices (wod.advantages.path.*). Sins are WoDX paraphrases in our own words; the book's rationales are not reproduced.

blood.name: Path of Blood
sins: Taking a mortal's life to feed
Going back on a promise made to a clanmate
Not giving an outsider the chance to convert
Sparing outside Kindred who refuse the teaching
Neglecting to study the lore of the enemy
Not claiming vitae as the price of a service
Withholding help from a senior follower
Turning against a fellow member of the clan

bones.name: Path of the Bones
sins: Letting a fear of dying show
Passing up the chance to study a death
Passing up a chance to kill
Choosing by feeling instead of reason
Going out of one's way to help someone
Stopping a death for no good reason
Stepping in to save a life

caine.name: Path of Caine
sins: A night without study or research
Not teaching the Path to other Kindred
Making friends of mortals or living among them
Disrespecting a fellow student of Caine
Not riding the wave of a frenzy
Giving in to the Red Fear
Passing up the diablerie of a Kindred who clings to Humanity
Never testing the limits of one's powers
Ignoring a chance to learn about vampires
Denying one's vampiric nature (no feeding, showing mercy, no self-study)

cathari.name: Path of Cathari
sins: Not Embracing the deeply wicked or the deeply good
Not riding the wave of a frenzy
Giving up a pleasure for another's sake

feralheart.name: Path of the Feral Heart
sins: Hunting with tools instead of one's own gifts
Staying near fire or sunlight except to kill a foe
Killing when there is no need
Killing for any reason but survival
Not killing when survival calls for it

accord.name: Path of Honorable Accord
sins: Falling short of any of the group's precepts
Being a poor host to allies
Breaking one's word, oath or bargain

lilith.name: Path of Lilith
sins: Letting false tales of Caine and Lilith stand

metamorphosis.name: Path of Metamorphosis
sins: Passing up a killing that could teach something
Not experimenting, even when it is risky

night.name: Path of Night
sins: Killing on purpose or in passion

paradox.name: Path of Paradox
sins: Embracing someone from outside the jati
Sparing a vampire who follows another Path
Killing a mortal for any reason but survival
Not helping another toward their svadharma
Putting sect business before one's dharma
Embracing without need or out of desire

innervoice.name: Path of Power and the Inner Voice
sins: Not owning up to one's actions
Not killing when it serves you
Going along with someone else's mistake
Not using the best means of control
Turning down a chance at power

typhon.name: Path of Typhon
sins: Feeding one's own vices instead of someone else's
Sparing a vampire who has reached Golconda
Not working to overturn the social order for the Setites
Getting in a fellow Setite's way
